connector.name: emem, the verifiable memory protocol for the physical world
connector.registryDescription: Shared, verifiable memory for AI agents and robots: signed tokens that resolve and verify offline.
connector.summary: Hosted at emem.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image emem:latest. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vortx-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PORT
env.description: PaaS port convention: the container entrypoint binds 0.0.0.0:$PORT when EMEM_BIND is not set explicitly. Falls back to 5051.

env.name: EMEM_BIND
env.description: Bind address for the HTTP server. When unset, the entrypoint derives it from PORT, falling back to 0.0.0.0:5051.

env.name: EMEM_DATA
env.description: Path to the persistent data directory (sled cache + ed25519 identity). Mount a volume here; on managed platforms that mount /data, set EMEM_DATA=/data.

env.name: EMEM_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Optional canonical origin for self-referencing URLs in MCP responses (e.g. https://emem.dev). When unset the server falls back to urn:emem.

env.name: EMEM_TLS_DOMAINS
env.description: Comma-separated hostnames for built-in Let's Encrypt ACME (TLS-ALPN-01). When set, the server binds 0.0.0.0:443 instead of EMEM_BIND.
